prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1420; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck by another car. The mechanism and force of the impact are consistent with the right shoulder injury reported. Over the course of 21 visits, care proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, with sessions gradually reduced in frequency as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Examination findings are mixed: several provocative tests of the shoulder reproduce pain and support the diagnosis, while other neurological and strength assessments remain within normal limits. Review of prior records shows the patient was treated for the same shoulder region within the past two years, and that earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Ongoing home exercise and activity modification are recommended, with follow-up as needed.
